entries.wording: 拉斯维加斯仓库已揽收
entries.english: Picked up by the Las Vegas warehouse
entries.note: The first row when a warehouse collects the parcel. The text names the warehouse.
The parcel is in the US warehouse.
Packed out of the US warehouse.

entries.english: Loaded, on its way to the airport
entries.note: Leaves for the flight to China.

entries.wording: 已到达国内机场，准备清关
entries.english: Arrived at the airport in China, about to clear customs

entries.wording: 包裹到达中国口岸，正在办理清关手续
entries.english: Arrived at the port of entry in China, clearing customs
entries.note: The first row in China, the parcel already in customs.
The last row; the courier in China delivers from here.

entries.wording: 包裹清关完成,进入国内物流环节，请耐心等待派送
entries.english: Cleared, handed to the courier in China, waiting for delivery
entries.note: The last row; the courier in China delivers from here.
